mapper.select: select fq.id as favoriteId, fq.que_id as queId, fq.create_time as favoriteTime, q.course_id as courseId, q.type, q.description, q.content, q.choice_a as choiceA, q.choice_b as choiceB, q.choice_c as choiceC, q.choice_d as choiceD, q.choice_e as choiceE, q.choice_f as choiceF, q.answer, q.answer_explain as answerExplain, q.img_url as imgUrl, q.img_id as imgId from favorites_que fq inner join que q on fq.que_id = q.id where fq.user_id = #{userId} and q.del_flag = '0' order by fq.create_time desc, fq.id desc
